Question B-005-010-007.

Why the correct answer is right: A ferrite-cored coil can present high reactance at radio frequencies. That high radio-frequency (RF) opposition helps reduce unwanted RF current.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Low reactance at radio frequencies": Low RF reactance would let the offending radio signal pass instead of impeding it.
- sourceIndex 2: "Low reactance at audio frequencies": Audio-frequency behaviour does not explain why the coil mitigates an unwanted RF signal.
- sourceIndex 3: "High reactance at audio frequencies": High audio reactance might disturb wanted audio, but the interference-control property here is high opposition at RF.
